connector.name: BananaBanana Image & Video Generation
connector.registryDescription: Generate images & video (Nano Banana, Veo, Omni) pay-as-you-go. No subscription, crypto payments.
connector.summary: Hosted at bananabanana.pro over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace pro.bananabanana, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer credential. Leave empty if your client signs in with OAuth 2.1 (claude.ai, Claude Desktop/Code, MCP Inspector) — it obtains the token itself. Otherwise put an API key here as 'Bearer bb_live_…'; create one at https://bananabanana.pro/profile.
